pattern: Notification region (labelled section landmark) with announcements through shared visually hidden live regions (WCAG 4.1.3); toasts are not live regions themselves, to avoid double announcements.

aria.value: id of the text block (tone prefix, title, message)
polite for info/success, assertive for warning/error

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the newest toast; timers pause while focus is inside.
Moves through the action and dismiss buttons and between toasts.
Dismisses that toast and returns focus to where it was before entering the region.
Runs onAction, then closes the toast (reason action).
Closes the toast (reason dismiss) and returns focus.

focus: Toasts never take focus on their own. The hotkey focuses the newest toast (tabindex=-1, visible focus ring). When a focused toast closes, focus returns to the element focused before entering the region, else to the newest remaining toast.
notes: Timers pause while the pointer is over the region or focus is inside it (WCAG 2.2.1); error toasts persist until dismissed by default.
Tone is conveyed by an icon and a visually hidden, localized prefix, never by color alone; the prefix is part of the announcement.
DOM order matches visual order (newest nearest the viewport edge).
While a modal dialog is open, the region moves inside it so new toasts are above the dialog and not inert.
knownCaveats: Announcements use the shared live regions in document.body, which are outside an open modal dialog; screen readers may not announce toasts while a modal is open.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
